name: Dachi Mindadze
medium: Ink, brush and pen drawing with watercolour and acrylic washes, sometimes collage and oil stick, on warm toned paper
colour: sepia and warm cream paper grounds and dense black ink, with bold patches of crimson red, magenta, chrome yellow and a little sky blue
form: figures and animals — horses, bulls, dogs, lone men — drawn with fast scratchy pen lines and heavy dry-brush ink, loose scribbled details and collage fragments around them; long, gangly, distorted anatomy
never: never neat or polished, never smooth digital rendering, never realistic proportions, never printed text or letters
mood: restless, witty and a little melancholic
consent: VERBAL agreement — the owner, 2026-09-26 (his standing word: an artist he asks to test has agreed verbally). A short written agreement (share, credit, withdrawal) is still to be signed before any label is sold.
bio: Davit (Dachi) Mindadze, born in 1985, is a self-taught Georgian painter and one of the most distinctive voices of his generation. His neo-expressionist work is raw and energetic — often painted in oil, acrylic and mixed media on unconventional surfaces such as nut sacks, where the rough weave becomes part of the picture. (Draft biography — to be completed with the artist.)
